label: Has gene template
summary: Whether the character has a given template of a given gene category.
details: Only works for morph genes (the genes that shape the face and body). The game marks it as an interface trigger, so it can only be used in specific places, not in ordinary events or effects.

fields.name: category
fields.text: The gene category to look at.

fields.name: template
fields.text: The template inside that category the character must have.

label: Has global variable
summary: Whether a global variable with the given name has been set.
details: Global variables are stored for the whole game rather than on one character or title. The game's documentation says "current scope", which does not match the name, so the game's documentation is unclear on this point. Vanilla values include tutorial_completed, tenno_restored and shogunate_established.

label: Has global variable list
summary: Whether a global variable list with the given name has been set.
details: A variable list is a collection of values stored under one name. The check only asks whether the list exists. The documented usage line names has_variable_list, which looks like a typo. Vanilla values include laamps_tally, efg_empire_holders and hre_elector_list.

label: Has government
summary: Whether the character's government is the given type.
details: Vanilla uses it most often with landless_adventurer_government, and also with nomad_government, herder_government, ecclesiastical_government and the Japanese feudal and administrative governments.

label: Has graphical faith
summary: Whether the faith uses the given graphical faith (a named set of visuals for the faith).
details: Runs on a faith. The documented example is `orthodoxgfx`.

label: Has great building
summary: Whether the province's holding has a great building.
details: Runs on a province. Write `yes` to require one and `no` to require none. Vanilla mostly uses `no`.

label: Has great building slot
summary: Whether the province's holding has a great building slot.
details: Runs on a province. Write `yes` or `no`.

label: Focus held for days
summary: Whether the character has had a focus for the given number of days.
details: Compare with `>`, `>=`, `<`, `<=`, `=` or `!=`, for example `> 30`. The game's documentation is terse and does not say whether it means the current focus, so that reading is an assumption. All six vanilla uses are `> 30`.

label: Has a holding
summary: Whether the province has a holding.
details: Runs on a province. Write `yes` or `no`.

label: Holding type has parameter
summary: Whether the holding type has the given parameter.
details: Runs on a holding type, not on a province. The value is the parameter's name.

label: Holding type
summary: Whether the province has a holding of the given type.
details: Runs on a province. The documented example is `castle_holding`. Vanilla uses nomad, herder, church, tribal, city, castle and temple citadel holdings most.

label: Holy site has parameter
summary: Whether the barony has a holy site with the given parameter.
details: Runs on a barony title. The value is the parameter's name.

label: Has hook on
summary: Whether the character has a hook (a favor they can call in) on the given character.
details: The hook holder is the character the check runs on; the character written after `=` is the one the hook is on. To check for a certain kind of hook, use the hook-of-type check.

label: Has hook from secret
summary: Whether the character has a hook that is based on the given secret.
details: The value must be a secret, for example one saved earlier as a scope. Vanilla uses it only once.

label: Has hook of type
summary: Whether the character has a hook of the given type on the given target.
details: Vanilla uses types such as favor_hook, weak_blackmail_hook and strong_blackmail_hook.

fields.name: target
fields.text: The character the hook is on.

label: House claims artifact
summary: Whether the dynasty house has a personal claim on the given artifact.
details: Runs on a dynasty house. The value is the artifact. Vanilla uses it twice.

label: House aspiration parameter
summary: Whether the house's house power (its aspiration) has the given parameter.
details: Runs on a dynasty house. It can only check parameters that are on or off. Vanilla uses it a lot, with values such as aspect_of_creation, aspect_of_destruction, aspect_of_serenity and aspect_of_trickery.

label: House head parameter
summary: Whether the house's head has the given parameter.
details: Runs on a dynasty house. It can only check parameters that are on or off. Vanilla values include creator_30_year_modifier, may_override_martial_succession_trial and unlock_befriend_scheme.

label: House modifier
summary: Whether the house has the given modifier.
details: Runs on a dynasty house.

label: House modifier time left
summary: Whether the house has time left on the given modifier.
details: The game's documentation says only that it checks "the duration remaining" and shows no way to give a number, so how the time is compared is unknown. Vanilla does not use it.

label: House relation level
summary: Whether the house relation is at the given level.
details: Runs on a house relation (the relation between two houses). Vanilla uses levels from feud and rivalry up to friendly and amity.

label: House relation parameter
summary: Whether the house relation has the given parameter.
details: Runs on a house relation. Vanilla values include members_more_likely_to_scheme_hostile, increased_marriage_acceptance and more_likely_war_target.

label: Has house relation with
summary: Whether there is a house relation between this house and the given house.
details: Runs on a dynasty house. The value is the other house.

label: Has house unity
summary: Whether the house has house unity.
details: Runs on a dynasty house. Write `yes` or `no`. Vanilla uses it once.

label: House unity modifier
summary: Whether the house has the given house unity modifier.
details: Runs on a dynasty house that has unity. Vanilla uses seven modifiers, one each, such as unity_antagonistic_maa_modifier and unity_friendly_bailiff_modifier.

label: Unity modifier time left
summary: Whether the house has time left on the given modifier.
details: The game's documentation says only that it checks "the duration remaining" and shows no way to give a number, so how the time is compared is unknown. Its documentation text mentions only a house, not house unity, and vanilla does not use it.

label: House unity parameter
summary: Whether the house's unity has the given parameter.
details: Runs on a dynasty house. It can only check parameters that are on or off. Vanilla values include unity_unlock_fabricate_hooks, unity_unlimited_invasions and unity_can_challenge_house_head.

label: House unity stage
summary: Whether the house's unity is at the given stage.
details: Runs on a dynasty house. Vanilla uses the stages antagonistic, competitive, impassive, friendly and harmonious.

label: Has icon
summary: Whether the faith has the given icon.
details: Runs on a faith.

label: Has imprisonment reason
summary: Whether the character has an imprisonment reason towards the given character.
details: The game's documentation does not say which of the two is the jailer and which the prisoner, so that direction is not known. Vanilla mostly writes a saved scope such as `scope:recipient` as the value.

label: Has inactive trait
summary: Whether the character has the given trait, or a trait of the given trait group, among their inactive traits.
details: The game keeps inactive traits as their own list on the character. Vanilla uses it with genetic traits: possessed_genetic, depressed_genetic and lunatic_genetic.

label: Has innovation
summary: Whether the culture has discovered the given innovation.
details: Runs on a culture. The value is the innovation key.

label: Has innovation flag
summary: Whether the culture has discovered an innovation that has the given flag.
details: Runs on a culture. The value is the flag's name.

label: Innovation has parameter
summary: Whether the innovation type has the given parameter.
details: Runs on an innovation type, not on a culture. Vanilla uses it three times, all with silk_road_innovation_parameter.

label: Kind of inspiration
summary: Whether the inspiration is of the given type.
details: Runs on an inspiration. Vanilla uses types such as adventure, alchemy, smith, book, armor, weapon, weaver and artisan inspiration.

label: Has a leading house
summary: Whether the confederation has a leading house.
details: Runs on a confederation. Write `yes` or `no`.

label: Has legend chapter
summary: Whether the legend has the named chapter, optionally with a given text set for it.
details: The short form, `has_legend_chapter = opening`, only checks the chapter name. The block form also checks which text key the chapter uses. Vanilla uses chapter names such as opening, motivation, battle and conclusion.

fields.name: name
fields.values: a chapter name, such as `opening` or `extra_deed`

fields.name: localization_key
fields.text: The text the chapter must have.

label: Has legend chronicle
summary: Whether the legend has the given legend chronicle.
details: Runs on a legend. Vanilla uses it with chronicles such as ancient_people, holy_warrior and beast_slayer.

label: Legend county modifier
summary: Whether the legend has the given modifier that affects counties.
details: Runs on a legend.

label: Legend modifier time left
summary: Whether the legend has time left on the given county modifier.
details: The game's documentation says only that it checks "the duration remaining" and shows no way to give a number, so how the time is compared is unknown. Vanilla does not use it.
